item.title: [翻译] TLDR AI: 谷歌400亿投资Anthropic、AI经营商店与Claude智能体记忆
item.description:
标签: #AI投资 #智能体 #企业应用 #大模型

摘要: 谷歌计划向Anthropic投资高达400亿美元以支持其AI算力扩张，Anthropic则同步推出企业版Claude代理的跨会话记忆功能；与此同时，旧金山首家AI运营实体店的持续亏损实验，揭示了当前智能体技术在现实商业落地中的挑战。

原标题: Google Anthropic $40B deal 💰, AI run store 🏪, Claude Agent Memory 🧠

TLDR AI 2026-04-27

Google Anthropic $40B deal 💰, AI run store 🏪, Claude Agent Memory 🧠

2026 Threat Report: AI is Accelerating Cloud Risk (Sponsor)

Many assume that AI is creating more complex exploits - but that's not always the real story.

许多人认为 AI 正在制造更复杂的攻击手段——但这并非总是真实情况。

Research by Wiz reveals that 80% of cloud breaches still start with the basics - andAI is making them faster.

Wiz 的研究显示，80% 的云安全漏洞仍然始于基础问题——而 AI 正在让这些攻击变得更快。

The2026 Cloud Threat Report leverages past investigations into events like Shai-Hulud, S1ngularity, and React2Shell to explore:
  • How systemic weaknesses can allow for dramatically outsized impact
  • How AI is fundamentally changing the game by radically accelerating attack velocity and expanding the attack surface

《2026 云威胁报告》利用对 Shai-Hulud、S1ngularity 和 React2Shell 等事件的过往调查，探讨了：

  • 系统性弱点如何可能导致影响被急剧放大
  • AI 如何通过急剧加速攻击速度和扩大 attack surface（攻击面），从根本上改变游戏规则

The result is larger, faster incidents driven by issues that already exist across most environments.

其结果是，由已存在于大多数环境中的问题所驱动的更大规模、更快速的安全事件。

See how today's cloud attacks work

了解当今云攻击的运作方式

Google will invest as much as $40 billion in Anthropic (2 minute read)

Google will invest between $10 billion and $40 billion in Anthropic. The amount depends on whether Anthropic can meet certain performance targets. Anthropic recently received a $5 billion investment from Amazon, with an option for more investment based on performance. The investments value Anthropic at $350 billion. The funds will help the startup close the gap between demand and supply of compute（算力） for AI training and inference（推理）.

Google 将向 Anthropic 投资 100 亿至 400 亿美元。具体金额取决于 Anthropic 能否达成某些业绩目标。Anthropic 最近从 Amazon 获得了 50 亿美元投资，并有权根据业绩表现获得更多投资。这些投资使 Anthropic 的估值达到 3500 亿美元。这笔资金将帮助这家初创公司缩小 AI 训练与 inference（推理）所需的 compute（算力）供需缺口。

What Happens When AI Runs a Store in San Francisco? (7 minute read)

Andon Labs is running an experiment to see whether AI agents（AI 智能体） can run real-world endeavors. It opened a retail boutique on April 10 run by an agent named Luna. Luna has so far struggled with employee schedules and seems to be unable to stop ordering candles. The experiment's mission was to make a profit, but it has lost $13,000 since the shop's opening.

Andon Labs 正在进行一项实验，以验证 AI agents（AI 智能体）是否能经营现实世界的商业项目。该公司于 4 月 10 日开设了一家零售精品店，由名为 Luna 的智能体管理。到目前为止，Luna 在员工排班方面遇到了困难，而且似乎无法停止订购蜡烛。该实验的任务是盈利，但自开业以来已亏损 13,000 美元。

Anthropic launches Memory in Claude Agents for enterprise (1 minute read)

Anthropic has released a feature for Claude Managed Agents called Memory. It allows agents to remember and use information from prior sessions and accumulate knowledge over time without requiring manual prompt updates. Memory is a filesystem-based layer, so data is stored as files that can be exported, managed through APIs, and scoped with permissions for various organizational needs. The feature is available now in public beta to all Managed Agents users.

Anthropic 为 Claude Managed Agents 发布了一项名为 Memory 的功能。它允许智能体记住并使用先前会话中的信息，并随时间积累知识，无需手动更新提示词。Memory 是一个基于文件系统的层，因此数据以文件形式存储，可以导出、通过 APIs 管理，并可根据各种组织需求设置权限范围。该功能目前以公开测试版形式向所有 Managed Agents 用户开放。

Google prepares credits system for Gemini (2 minute read)

Google is working on a credit-based system for its Gemini app where users receive a monthly allowance to spend across models and features. Users will be able to top up when they run out of credits. The change will make budgeting for heavy workloads more predictable and give Google a cleaner lever for introducing premium features without forcing users to pay for more expensive plans. OpenAI, Anthropic, and Notion already use a similar consumption model.

Google 正为其 Gemini 应用开发一种基于积分的系统，用户每月获得一定配额，可在不同模型和功能之间使用。积分耗尽时，用户可以进行充值。这一变化将使高负载工作的预算更可预测，并为 Google 提供一个更清晰的杠杆来引入高级功能，而无需强迫用户购买更昂贵的套餐。OpenAI、Anthropic 和 Notion 已经采用了类似的消耗模式。

Your AI Might Be Lying to Your Boss (22 minute read)

It's very hard to measure the contribution that AI models make to a codebase（代码库）. Sometimes the best use cases for AI are inquisitive prompts that don't necessarily produce any code at all. Lines of code isn't a very good measure of code quality, and it can be difficult to separate the work engineers did vs what AI has done. The bias appears to be towards reporting a higher AI percentage, which is great for AI companies, but skewed metrics can be harmful.

衡量 AI 模型对 codebase（代码库）的贡献非常困难。有时 AI 的最佳使用场景是探索性的提示词，这些提示词未必会生成任何代码。代码行数并非衡量代码质量的很好指标，而且很难区分哪些是工程师完成的工作，哪些是 AI 完成的。目前的偏见似乎倾向于报告更高的 AI 占比，这对 AI 公司有利，但扭曲的指标可能带来危害。

Monitoring LLM behavior: Drift, retries, and refusal patterns (11 minute read)

Monitoring LLM（大语言模型） behavior necessitates adopting the AI Evaluation Stack, separating tests into deterministic assertions (syntax and routing integrity) and model-based evaluations (semantic quality). Engineers use offline pipelines for pre-deployment regression testing with human-reviewed "Golden Datasets" while online pipelines monitor real-world performance for drift and failures. A continuous feedback loop from production telemetry ensures AI systems adapt, maintaining high performance as user behavior evolves.

监控 LLM（大语言模型）行为需要采用 AI Evaluation Stack（AI 评估栈），将测试分为确定性断言（语法和路由完整性）和基于模型的评估（语义质量）。工程师使用离线流水线进行部署前的回归测试，配合人工审核的"Golden Datasets（黄金数据集）"；而在线流水线则监控真实世界中的性能漂移和故障。来自生产遥测数据的持续反馈回路确保 AI 系统能够自适应，在用户行为演变时保持高性能。

The World Can't Keep Up With AI Labs (9 minute read)

Coding agents（编程智能体） are the first AI product people are paying for at volume and regularly. However, compute demand has started to grow faster than anyone can build it out. The industry isn't ready for the agent boom. The most obvious move for AI labs now is to cut limits and raise prices.

Coding agents（编程智能体）是人们首次大规模且定期付费购买的 AI 产品。然而，算力需求已经开始超过任何人的建设速度。整个行业尚未为智能体热潮做好准备。AI 实验室目前最明显的举措就是削减使用限制并提高价格。

👨‍💻

👨‍💻

Engineering & Research

You don't need an all-powerful, token-hungry LLM for enterprise automation (Sponsor)

is the AI copilot built into Redwood's RunMyJobs. Designed for what enterprises actually care about: privacy, security, and accuracy -- specifically trained for your enterprise workflows. Troubleshoot job failures, generate scripts from prompts, and auto-document your processes without exposing sensitive data or racking up token costs. Less backlog. Lower MTTR（平均修复时间）.

这是内置于 Redwood 旗下 RunMyJobs 的 AI 副驾驶（AI copilot）。专为企业真正关心的需求而设计：隐私、安全与准确性——并针对您的企业工作流进行了专门训练。排查作业故障、根据提示词生成脚本、自动记录流程文档，所有这些都无需暴露敏感数据或累积高昂的 token 成本。减少积压。降低 MTTR（平均修复时间）。

Vision Banana Generalist Model (39 minute read)

Instruction-tuned（指令微调） image generation models can act as generalist vision systems, achieving state-of-the-art（最先进） results across tasks by reframing perception as image generation.

经过 instruction-tuned（指令微调）的图像生成模型可以作为通用视觉系统，通过将感知重新定义为图像生成，在各项任务上达到 state-of-the-art（最先进）的成果。

Stash (GitHub Repo)

Stash is a tool that gives agents persistent memory. It enables agents to remember, recall, consolidate memories, and learn across sessions. Stash is open source, self-hosted, and works with any MCP（Model Context Protocol，模型上下文协议）-compatible agent.

Stash 是一款为智能体提供持久化记忆的工具。它使智能体能够记忆、回忆、整合记忆，并在多个会话之间学习。Stash 是开源的、可自托管的，并且兼容任何支持 MCP（Model Context Protocol，模型上下文协议）的智能体。

Efficient Video Intelligence in 2026 (21 minute read)

Efficient video intelligence advances include compact universal vision encoders like EUPE, which distill capabilities from specialized models such as DINO and SAM. Techniques like LongVU use adaptive token allocation and compression for long-form video understanding while edge and on-device deployment handle real-time processing. Persistent challenges include streaming understanding, sparse-event detection, real-time sub-watt inference for AR glasses（增强现实眼镜）, and robust multi-modal reasoning.

高效视频智能的进展包括紧凑的通用视觉编码器，如 EUPE，它从 DINO 和 SAM 等专业模型中提炼能力。LongVU 等技术利用自适应 token 分配和压缩来实现长视频理解，而边缘和端侧部署则处理实时推理。持续存在的挑战包括流式理解、稀疏事件检测、面向 AR glasses（增强现实眼镜）的实时亚瓦特级推理，以及稳健的多模态推理。

Scaling Long-Horizon Coding Agents (28 minute read)

A framework from Meta for test-time scaling（测试时扩展） in coding agents summarized past rollouts into structured representations, enabling better selection and reuse to improve benchmark performance.

来自 Meta 的一个框架，用于编程智能体的 test-time scaling（测试时扩展），将过去的部署总结为结构化表示，从而实现更好的选择和重用，以提升基准测试性能。

Meta's loss is Thinking Machines' gain (3 minute read)

Thinking Machines Lab has been hiring more researchers from Meta than from any other single employer. The AI startup is expanding on multiple fronts, and it just signed a multibillion-dollar cloud deal with Google that gives it access to Nvidia's latest GB300 chips. Meta's large pay packages are well known, but Thinking Machines' $12 billion valuation and 140-employee count mean there's still a lot of financial upside to joining the startup.

Thinking Machines Lab 从 Meta 招聘的研究人员比从任何其他单一雇主招聘的都多。这家 AI 初创公司正在多条战线上扩张，并且刚刚与 Google 签署了一项价值数十亿美元的云协议，使其能够获得 Nvidia 最新的 GB300 芯片。Meta 的高薪待遇众所周知，但 Thinking Machines 120 亿美元的估值和 140 名员工规模意味着加入这家初创公司仍有很大的财务上升空间。

OpenAI Posts Five-Principle Framework for AGI, Altman Concedes Bigger Role (2 minute read)

OpenAI has published a five-principle framework for the development of artificial general intelligence. It is the company's most prominent statement of intent since its 2018 Charter. The lab claims it will resist letting the technology consolidate power in the hands of the few. The framework arrives at a time when US and European regulators are tightening oversight of frontier AI labs.

OpenAI 发布了一份关于通用人工智能（AGI（Artificial General Intelligence））开发的五项原则框架。这是该公司自 2018 年章程以来最重大的意向声明。该实验室声称将抵制让这项技术将权力集中在少数人手中。该框架发布之际，美国和欧洲监管机构正在加强对前沿 AI 实验室的监督。

Cursor's $60 Billion Escape Hatch (5 minute read)

What does it mean when a company doing $2.7B in annualized revenue has gross margins of negative 23%? In Cursor's case, it means AI coding tools have inverted the old SaaS（软件即服务） playbook, where serving the next customer is supposed to be cheap. Power users consume more model capacity and compute, so the best customers can become the most expensive. That reframes the rumored SpaceX deal as more than a $60B headline. Access to Colossus would loosen Cursor's dependence on Anthropic and OpenAI fees, where that negative 23% lives.

一家年化收入达 27 亿美元的公司，毛利率却为负 23%，这意味着什么？就 Cursor 而言，这意味着 AI 编程工具颠覆了旧的 SaaS（软件即服务）playbook——在该模式下，服务下一位客户本应很便宜。重度用户消耗更多的模型容量和算力，因此最好的客户可能成为最昂贵的客户。这使得传闻中的 SpaceX 交易不仅仅是一个 600 亿美元的新闻标题。获得 Colossus（巨像系统）的使用权将减轻 Cursor 对 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 费用的依赖，而负 23% 的毛利率正源于这些费用。

item.title: [翻译] Lenny's Newsletter: 从6.90美元简报到300万美元API：非程序员如何打造Memelord
item.description:
标签: #无代码创业 #AI梗图 #API产品

摘要: 非编码创业者Jason Levin回顾了Memelord从月费6.90美元邮件简报起步，借助Bubble无代码平台做到10万美元年收入，再融资300万美元转型为API优先的AI表情包平台的创业历程。文章还介绍了他在"无UX"产品设计、AI智能体应用及团队vibe-coding等方面的独特实践与思考。

原标题: From a $6.90 newsletter to $3M API: How a non-coder built Memelord | Jason Levin

From a $6.90 newsletter to $3M API: How a non-coder built Memelord | Jason Levin

从每月6.90美元的通讯到300万美元的API：一位非程序员如何打造Memelord | Jason Levin

Jason Levin is the CEO and founder of Memelord, an AI-powered meme creation platform that helps brands and individuals create contextual, trending memes. He started Memelord as a $6.90-per-month newsletter sending subscribers to a Google Slides deck, grew it to $100K ARR on Bubble without hiring engineers, then raised $3M to build it into an API-first product.

Jason Levin 是 Memelord 的 CEO 兼创始人，这是一个 AI-powered（AI驱动的）模因创作平台，帮助品牌和个人创作贴合语境、紧跟热点的模因。他将 Memelord 从一份每月 6.90 美元、给订阅者发送 Google Slides 链接的通讯做起，在不雇佣工程师的情况下，借助 Bubble 将其发展到 10 万美元 ARR（年度经常性收入），随后融资 300 万美元，将其打造为一款 API-first（API优先） 产品。

Listen or watch on YouTube, Spotify, or Apple Podcasts

在 YouTube、Spotify 或 Apple Podcasts 上收听或观看

What you’ll learn:

你将学到什么：

  • How Jason grew Memelord from a $6.90/month newsletter to $100K ARR without writing a single line of code
  • Why “no UX is the best UX” and how agents are becoming Memelord’s primary users
  • The mandatory vibe-coding rule for his marketing team and how it unlocks unprecedented creativity
  • Why free tools are the new PDF downloads and how they’ve generated hundreds of thousands of emails
  • Jason’s hardware hacking projects, including a bedside keyboard that creates Linear tickets without waking his wife
  • Why AI can be funny (but humans are still funnier) and which model is the funniest
  • The philosophy of building hyper-personalized software just for yourself

• 为什么“没有 UX（用户体验） 就是最好的 UX”，以及 agents（智能体） 如何成为 Memelord 的主要用户

item.title: [翻译] Simon Willison: Google Meet语音翻译功能登陆移动设备
item.description:
标签: #语音翻译 #谷歌会议 #移动端

摘要: Google Meet 的实时语音翻译功能正陆续登陆移动设备，目前支持英语、西班牙语等六种语言互译，并能以近似原声的语音播报译文；不过该功能仍处于早期测试阶段，实际使用中存在兼容性和稳定性问题。

原标题: Speech translation in Google Meet is now rolling out to mobile devices

Speech translation in Google Meet is now rolling out to mobile devices

Google Meet 的语音翻译功能现正面向移动设备推出

This is Google's implementation of the ultimate sci-fi translation app, where two people can talk to each other in two separate languages and Meet translates from one to the other and - with a short delay - repeats the text in your preferred language, with a rough imitation of the original speaker's voice.

这是 Google 对终极科幻翻译（sci-fi translation）应用的实现：两人可用各自不同的语言实时交谈，Meet 会在短暂延迟后将一方的发言翻译并转述为对方的首选语言（preferred language），同时大致模仿原始说话者的嗓音。

It can only handle English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, and Italian at the moment. It's also still very alpha - I ran it successfully between two laptops running web browsers, but then when I tried between an iPhone and an iPad it didn't seem to work.

该功能目前仅支持英语、西班牙语、法语、德语、葡萄牙语和意大利语。此外，它仍处于非常早期的 alpha（内测）阶段——我曾在两台运行网页浏览器的笔记本电脑之间成功运行，但在 iPhone 与 iPad 之间测试时，该功能似乎无法正常工作。
